label: The cost of a label
subgoals: Multiply designs by variants to count flow runs
Multiply runs by hours per run for machine-hours
Divide machine-hours by parallel machines and 24 for days

label: Samples per run
subgoals: Divide die dimensions by gcell size to count gcells per run
Multiply gcells per run by the number of runs
Count distinct designs as the effective sample size

label: Break-even reuse
subgoals: Add labeling and training hours for the fixed cost
Subtract inference time from tool time for the saving per query
Divide fixed cost by saving and round up past break-even
